title: Flame Spread of Interior Combustible Ceiling Finish

facts.text: The guide calls this a long-form sample alternative solution and says its format follows the City of Vancouver alternative-solution template.

The described building is a new 12-storey mixed-use office tower over a 3-level below-grade parkade, with encapsulated mass timber above grade, noncombustible below grade, the listed retail/restaurant/school/business-service occupancies, and sprinkler, standpipe, fire alarm and detection systems.

The sample proposes 25 mm Pacific Coast yellow cedar planks at the first-storey entry lobby and public corridors. It states the cedar has an FSR of 50 under CAN/ULC-S102 and discusses a fire-retardant coating anonymized as Product X.

The sample cites Sentence 3.1.18.12.(3), identifies Sentence 3.1.18.2.(1) as the root acceptable solution and lists F02-OS1.2 and F02-OP1.2; it also describes a 25 FSR criterion and coating, cut-end touch-up, inspection and maintenance proposals.

The sample says manufacturer data sheets indicate Product X achieved FSR 20 on red oak under CAN/ULC-S102 and describes an ASTM E2768 report excerpt, but neither the product identity nor the cited data sheet/report is included in the guide.
